name: Veralto
outlook:
What Veralto says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: sales, margin, earningsFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company anticipates non-GAAP core sales growth in the range of 5.5% to 6.5% year-over-year. Adjusted operating profit margin is expected to be approximately 24.5%, broadly in line with the prior year period, net of growth investments and the impact from acquisitions. The Company’s fourth quarter adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance is in the range of $1.13 to $1.16 per share.
  • Full year 2026: sales, margin, earningsFor the full year 2026, the Company raised its non-GAAP core sales growth to a range of 4.2% to 4.5% year-over-year, up from the prior guidance range of 4.0% to 4.5%. Adjusted operating profit margin is now expected to expand approximately 50 basis points year-over-year, up from the prior guidance range of 25-50 basis points. The Company raised its guidance for adjusted diluted earnings to a range of $4.49 to $4.52 per share, up from the prior guidance range of $4.35 to $4.43 per share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
